categories.name: Online payments
categories.description: Paid on a website or inside an app, without the card being present. This is what banks mean by 'online spends'. Every merchant listed today is online.

categories.name: Food delivery
categories.description: Restaurant food ordered through a delivery app such as Swiggy or Zomato. Usually posted as restaurants (MCC 5812) or fast food (MCC 5814).

categories.name: Dining
categories.description: What banks call dining: restaurants, bars and fast food (MCC 5812, 5813, 5814). Food delivery apps post under these codes, so they carry this tag too.

categories.name: Quick commerce
categories.description: Groceries and essentials delivered in minutes (Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart). Codes vary by app: grocery (MCC 5411) for most; fast food (MCC 5814) is reported for Instamart.

categories.name: Grocery
categories.description: Groceries and supermarkets (MCC 5411). Some banks also count miscellaneous food stores (MCC 5499); check the bank's list before relying on this tag.

categories.name: Online shopping
categories.description: Online marketplaces and shops: Amazon and Flipkart (usually MCC 5399, general merchandise), and online fashion and beauty shops.

categories.name: Cabs
categories.description: Taxis and ride-hailing (MCC 4121). Banks usually treat this apart from 'transport' (railways, buses, tolls: MCC 4111, 4112, 4131, 4784).

categories.name: Movies and events
categories.description: Cinema and event tickets (MCC 7832, motion picture theatres; some live events post as MCC 7922).

categories.name: Travel
categories.description: Flights, hotels and holidays booked through a travel agency or app (MCC 4722). Airlines (MCC 3000-3350, 4511) and hotels (MCC 3501-3999, 7011) booked directly post under their own codes.

categories.name: Bills and recharges
categories.description: Phone, broadband, DTH and utility bills and prepaid recharges (MCC 4814 telecom, 4899 cable and other pay TV, 4900 utilities). Banks treat these apart from shopping: many cards pay nothing or a reduced rate on them, and a few co-branded cards pay extra.

categories.name: Train tickets
categories.description: Indian Railways tickets (MCC 4112 passenger railways; some banks also name 4011). Several cards exclude or cap railway payments and some charge a fee on them, unlike flights and travel agencies, so rail is not part of 'travel'.

categories.name: Electronics
categories.description: Electronics and appliance shops (MCC 5732 electronics stores; 5045 computers and 5722 household appliances are sometimes used). Some cards name electronics chains, and some exclude electronics from online bonuses.

categories.name: Pharmacy
categories.description: Chemists and online pharmacies (MCC 5912 drug stores and pharmacies; 5122 drugs wholesale is reported for some online pharmacies). Doctor consultations and lab tests in the same apps may post under medical codes (8011, 8071) instead.
